newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices weaken, eyes on Germany, U.S..
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices weaken, eyes on Germany, U.S..

text.p: Danish bond prices weakened somewhat on Thursday, with the market anxiously awaiting German budget forecasts and their implications for EMU, as well as key U.S. indicators due this afternoon.
"Until then there is not much prospect of significant movement," a dealer said.

At 0825 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was down 0.06 point from Wednesday's close, at 111.56, yielding 6.25 percent. The forthcoming benchmark seven percent state bond due 2007 was down 0.07 to 104.18, yielding 6.43 percent.
